checks.explanation: No credible alternative to the US dollar as the primary global reserve/settlement asset has emerged by the predicted end-2027 window; the dollar has remained dominant despite periodic BRICS de-dollarization rhetoric.
US long-term interest rates have stayed elevated in the roughly 4%+ range through 2025-2026 rather than reverting to the 2010s-era ~2% levels.
Federal spending has remained under pressure from entitlements, defense, and interest costs, but discretionary programs have not been broadly gutted to the extent predicted.
This is an open-ended, no-specific-date prediction about a future Google breakup that has not yet occurred, though litigation is ongoing.
Donald Trump won Pennsylvania in the 2024 presidential election, as predicted.
Donald Trump won Nevada in the 2024 presidential election, flipping the state from its 2020 Democratic result.
No evidence emerged of election fraud at a scale capable of altering the 2024 presidential election outcome.
Total 2024 turnout came in close to the predicted approximately 160 million votes.
No fraud at a scale sufficient to change the 2024 presidential outcome was found or substantiated.
